item.title: Making a dynamic memory allocator: CSAPP's malloc lab
item.description: This is a writeup for CSAPP’s malloc lab where I made my own dynamic memory allocator by implementing malloc(), free() and realloc().

item.title: Control Flow Hijack via Crafted VTable Entry
item.description:
This challenge is from the Breach CTF hosted by IITBreachers. It was a PWN challenge and it had a cpp source code and a binary file.

We craft a fake vtable entry to change the control flow to get the flag.

item.title: Reverse engineering a RISC-V binary picoCTF riscy business
item.description: Reverse Engineering a RISC-V binary with ghidra, qemu and GDB. This is the writeup for the “Riscy business” challenge in picoCTF website.
